verdict.rationale: Internal comment threads with @mentions beside a message are a reasonable thing to ask of an email service, so this axis applies to Fastmail. Nothing in the evidence pack documents internal comments, @mentions or shared side-threads on messages. The docs cover JMAP, filters, templates, snooze and scheduled send, none of which is this capability.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around
